llms.body:
# Tally – The simplest way to build forms, for free

> Tally is a no-code form builder that lets you create unlimited forms for free. It’s powerful, flexible, and loved by creators, startups, and modern teams.

## Basic Information
- [Product Overview](https://tally.so/features): Explore Tally’s full feature set including advanced customization, conditional logic, payments, file uploads, and hidden fields.
- [Templates Gallery](https://tally.so/templates): Start fast with ready-to-use templates for lead capture, feedback collection, job applications, and more.
- [Pricing](https://tally.so/pricing): Tally offers unlimited forms and submissions completely free (within fair‑use limits), while its paid Pro plan costs $29/month and adds features like removal of branding, custom domains, team collaboration, and more.
- [Changelog](https://tally.so/changelog): See all recent feature updates and improvements.
- [About Tally](https://tally.so/about): Learn more about our mission, team, and values.
- [Customers](https://tally.so/customers): What customers have to say about using Tally.

## Documentation
- [Help Center](https://tally.so/help): Full documentation with guides on form creation, sharing, automation, and analytics.
- [Tally API](https://developers.tally.so): With the Tally API developers can programmatically create forms, update input blocks, delete or fetch submissions and more.
- [Tally MCP server](https://developers.tally.so/api-reference/mcp): The Tally MCP server lets AI assistants create Tally forms and fetch submissions using natural language through the Model Context Protocol.

## Integrations
- [Integrations](https://tally.so/help/integrations): See all Integrations that are possible with Tally.
- [Zapier](https://tally.so/help/zapier-integration): Automate workflows with 6,000+ apps like Slack, Gmail, and Airtable.
- [Notion](https://tally.so/help/notion-integration): Sync form responses directly to your Notion databases.
- [Webhooks](https://tally.so/help/webhooks): Real-time form submission data for developers.
- [Google Sheets](https://tally.so/help/google-sheets-integration): With Tally's Google Sheets integration, you can send your Tally form responses straight to Google Sheets.
- [Make](https://tally.so/help/make-integration): With Make, you can send information between Tally and thousands of other apps to automate workflows.
- [Airtable](https://tally.so/help/airtable-integration): Combine the power of Tally and Airtable with our new integration, and send your Tally form responses to Airtable in just a few clicks.
- [Coda](https://tally.so/help/coda-integration): You can use Tally to send form responses to Coda and leverage all the power of Coda tables, including creating unique views, groupings, and charts.
- [Slack](https://tally.so/help/slack-integration): Use our Slack integration to get notified instantly when someone completes your Tally forms.
- [Pipedream](https://tally.so/help/pipedream-integration): Pipedream lets you create workflows and app integrations using event triggers, such as a Tally form submission.
- [Integrately](https://tally.so/help/integrately-integration): Use our Integrately integration to connect Tally to Google Sheets, Slack, ClickUp, Trello, and other apps.
- [Relay.app](https://tally.so/help/relay-app-integration): Use Relay.app to turn Tally form submissions into easy-to-use automations.
- [ApiX-Drive](https://tally.so/help/apix-drive-integration): The ApiX-Drive integration lets you send Tally form submissions to hundreds of apps without code.
- [Pluga](https://tally.so/help/pluga-integration): Pluga lets you send information between Tally and other apps, automating data collection.
- [Google Analytics](https://tally.so/help/google-analytics-integration): With our Google Analytics integration, you can easily track the visitor behavior of any of your Tally forms.
- [Facebook Pixel](https://tally.so/help/facebook-pixel-integration): By integrating the Facebook Pixel into your Tally forms, you can track visitor activity on your forms and measure the effectiveness of your ads.

## Optional
- [Privacy Policy](https://tally.so/help/privacy-policy): Learn how we handle user data and stay GDPR-compliant.
- [Terms of Service](https://tally.so/help/terms-conditions): Legal terms for using Tally.
